info.longName: Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of small-sized capitalization (“small cap”) companies selected for their growth potential. For purposes of the 80% policy, the fund's managers consider small cap companies to be those whose market capitalization falls within the 12-month range of the Russell 2000TM Growth Index.
